g.title: crate Async task execution and lifecycle.
crate::action `Action<T, I>`: a user-triggered async operation with a run policy.
crate::async_state `AsyncState<T>`: the one state shape of resources and actions.
crate::blocking Blocking operations with cancellation support.
crate::completion This module provides one-shot futures for host results.
crate::detached Track worker detach facts below execution and shutdown orchestration.
crate::drain Drain of queued actions on owner disposal, `close` and App exit.
crate::latest The one in-flight run of latest-wins work (a resource fetch, a `Latest` run).
crate::sealed Public-in-bounds traits that only this crate can name or implement.
crate::spawn This module runs owned futures on the UI thread.
crate::state Task state tracking and completion.
crate::worker_pool Worker threads that run blocking jobs, and their shutdown.
